case_semantics.input_hex: The complete input document, as bytes in lowercase hexadecimal.
case_semantics.limits: The six operation limits, passed unchanged; a value that is not a positive integer (a boolean, zero or a negative number) must be refused as configuration_error before any input is read.
case_semantics.schema_id: The schema identifier declared on the byte references, or null; it is a label and is not validated against a registry.
case_semantics.expect.canonical_hex: Canonicalisation succeeds and returns exactly these bytes.
case_semantics.expect.refusal: Canonicalisation refuses with this code; error_class names the toolkit's exception class for it.
case_semantics.expect.raw_bytes_reference: The byte reference of the input with digest basis raw_bytes. It identifies the bytes without parsing them, so it refuses only invalid limits (configuration_error); for every other case it is the stated five-field value.
case_semantics.expect.jcs_content_reference: The byte reference with digest basis jcs_content: the digest and length of the canonical bytes. It refuses exactly when canonicalisation refuses, with the same code; then it is null.
case_semantics.recovery: The id of a case in this pack that repairs this input, or null. Both cases are run.
case_semantics.note: Admission cases only: what the case shows, in words. Admission cases state no byte references.

reference_cases_excluded.registry_snapshot-canonical: 260526 bytes; the registry snapshot schema's canonical form is covered by its smaller sibling cases

sources.admission_cases: docs/contracts/evidence-core-v1.md (Examples table) and one reader-supplied case

admission_order.note: BOM, then `[[[[1]]]]`: Stage 3 runs before the BOM is refused in stage 4
`[NaN, {"a":1,"a":2}]`: Stage 4: the literal comes first in the text
`[{"a":1,"a":2}, NaN]`: Stage 4: the duplicate's object closes first
`[1e400, {"a":1,"a":2}]`: Stage 4 before stage 5, although the number comes first
`[1e400, "\ud800"]`: Stage 5: the number comes first in document order
`["\ud800", 1e400]`: Stage 5: the lone surrogate comes first
Stage 3 counts brackets outside strings only, so three brackets inside a string at depth 1 are admitted
